notes: `לִמְזִמָּה` → *wickedly* is retained as one fused unit: a single English word stands for the contiguous preposition and its absolute noun, headed on the noun carrying the lexeme (rules 40, 30).
The italic *thy name* is one `added` unit: `נָשָׂא`'s lexeme is already written by *take*, so the supplied object noun and the possessive standing on it do one office together (rules 44, 18, 2).
The written `אֲשֶׁר` takes the causal *For* (rule 11); the *And* opening the second colon is `added`, no waw standing there (rule 14).
